clue.text: Plans market town announced

indicators.note: announced means the town's name is taken as it sounds when spoken

parts.note: Devizes is a market town in Wiltshire, England

explanation.surface: Someone's itinerary is broadcast as a list of country towns.
explanation.walkthrough: DEVIZES, a market town in Wiltshire in south-west England, sounds just like the verb meaning plans.
explanation.definitionFit: To devise something is to plan or contrive it, so the verb form fits 'Plans'.

clue.text: Naturalist on the Timor Sea

definitions.meaning: Charles ..., the naturalist behind the theory of evolution
the capital of Australia's Northern Territory sits on the Timor Sea

explanation.definitionFit: One surname names both the Victorian evolutionist and the Australian port city.

clue.text: He scored every season

parts.note: a composer who wrote music for each of the year's four seasons, in a famous set of violin concertos

explanation.definitionFit: The Venetian composer wrote The Four Seasons, scoring spring, summer, autumn and winter.

clue.text: Lookin' round middle of sound for marine creature

indicators.note: round means one piece goes around the other, holding it inside

parts.note: lookin' is a clipped form of searching, written searchin'

indicators.note: middle of picks out the central letter of the word sound

explanation.surface: Someone peers about in the shallows hunting for a sea creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lookin'' drops its final G, so its synonym is clipped the same way. 'sound' looks like a noise but is a stretch of sea; only its middle letter is used.
explanation.definitionFit: The spiny echinoderm living on the seabed is a sea creature.

clue.text: Company that might make a packet

definitions.text: Company that might make a packet

parts.words: Company that might make a packet
parts.note: a packet is also a packet boat, a mail ship, so a firm making one constructs vessels rather than earning a fortune

explanation.definitionFit: A firm constructing ships could build a packet boat, the old mail-carrying vessel.

clue.text: Some panic if I capsize, swept back into the ocean

indicators.note: swept back means the letters found are read in the reverse direction
some means only part of the following words is taken, a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: A nervous sailor fears overturning and being washed back into the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' picks CIFICAP from panIC IF I CAPsize, and 'swept back' turns it round. 'into' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pacific is the largest ocean on Earth.

clue.text: Girl a guy needs

definitions.meaning: a short form of the girl's name Margaret
a guy is a tent rope, which is held down by a pin driven into the ground

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a girl's name and the pin a tent's guy rope is tied to.

clue.text: Butterfly often seen in a list

definitions.meaning: a British butterfly with ragged-edged orange wings
the punctuation mark separating items in a series

explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to a ragged-winged butterfly and to the punctuation mark separating listed items.

clue.text: Director joined the ranks with one

parts.note: soldiers who fell in took their places in line
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A film-maker enlists in the army alongside a comrade.
explanation.walkthrough: To fall in is the parade-ground order to form ranks, so 'joined the ranks' is FELL IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Federico Fellini was the Italian film director of La Dolce Vita.

clue.text: Dreadful scene with lad being washed

indicators.note: dreadful suggests something badly mangled, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A grubby boy causes an awful scene when made to have a bath.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dreadful' rearranges SCENE and LAD; 'with' and 'being' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Something cleansed has been cleaned thoroughly, which is what washing does.

clue.text: Showing anger with live broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so these letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: A live television programme exposes someone's temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' rearranges ANGER and LIVE; 'with' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Revealing and showing both mean exposing something to view, as in a revealing dress.

clue.text: Fight, in general, led by the writer

indicators.note: led by means the general's name comes after the writer's word

parts.note: the writer is the setter referring to themself, so me
Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general in the American Civil War

explanation.surface: A soldier recalls a battle in which a commander was guided by an author.
explanation.walkthrough: The general is Robert E. LEE, commander in the American Civil War; 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A melee is a confused hand-to-hand scuffle.

clue.text: Individual doing little except rest, primarily

definitions.text: Individual doing little except rest, primarily

indicators.note: primarily here means taking the primary, first, letter of each word

explanation.surface: A description of a lazy person who barely does anything but lounge about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'primarily' takes the first letters of the five words, and the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A loafer does little but rest, which the whole clue describes.

clue.text: Exclude poor Scot, an islander

parts.note: to bar someone is to exclude them
poor quality means bad
Ian is a typically Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: A Caribbean resident is turned away for being a hard-up Scotsman.
explanation.walkthrough: IAN is the Scottish form of John, a common crossword Scot; 'an' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Barbados lives on that Caribbean island.

clue.text: Dozens of bakers compete in this game

definitions.text: Dozens of bakers compete in this game

parts.words: Dozens of bakers compete in this game
parts.note: a baker's dozen is thirteen, the number of players on each side in one code of football

explanation.definitionFit: The thirteen-a-side code of rugby football matches a baker's dozen.

clue.text: When it gets dark, after the loyal toast?

definitions.text: When it gets dark, after the loyal toast?

parts.words: When it gets dark, after the loyal toast?
parts.note: the dusk hour when lamps must be lit, and also the moment at a formal dinner when smoking is allowed after toasting the monarch

explanation.walkthrough: At British formal dinners nobody smokes until the loyal toast to the monarch has been drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the official time vehicles must switch on lights, and the cigar moment after the toast.

clue.text: Pole 'n wire arranged to provide this?

definitions.text: Pole 'n wire arranged to provide this?

indicators.note: arranged means set out in a new order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Engineers set up posts and cable to deliver electricity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' rearranges POLE N WIRE ('n standing for and); the whole clue describes how such a supply is strung.
explanation.definitionFit: Electricity cables strung on poles carry electrical supply across country.

clue.text: Rations for the fleet?

parts.note: fleet can mean swift as well as a group of ships, so food for the swift

explanation.definitionFit: Fleet also means quick, and quickly served meals are what the phrase names.

clue.text: The construction of Rome wasn't so routine

definitions.text: The construction of Rome wasn't so routine

parts.words: The construction of Rome wasn't so routine
parts.note: the proverb says Rome was not built in a single day, so its building was no ordinary task

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes something done as part of an ordinary job, the opposite of building Rome.

clue.text: Callas disrupted a famous opera house

indicators.note: disrupted means thrown into disorder, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A celebrated soprano causes chaos at a great theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disrupted' rearranges CALLAS and A; Maria Callas, the soprano, famously sang at this house.
explanation.definitionFit: The Milan theatre is one of the best-known opera venues in the world.

clue.text: Required reading when there's disorder?

parts.note: an old law that had to be read aloud to a rioting crowd before it could be dispersed

explanation.walkthrough: Under the 1714 British law, an official had to read the proclamation to a disorderly crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1714 statute was read to unruly crowds, and to read someone it now means to scold them.

clue.text: New articles about treatment producing sickness

indicators.note: about means the articles go around the word for treatment

parts.note: a and a are two indefinite articles
use, as in the use or treatment of something

explanation.surface: Fresh reports on a medical cure are making people feel ill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'articles' gives two As, and 'about' puts them round USE; 'producing' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Nausea is the feeling of sickness in the stomach.

clue.text: Special military unit somehow tracks foe

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters get there in some unspecified way, so rearrange them

explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' rearranges TRACKS and FOE.
explanation.definitionFit: A force assembled for a particular operation is a special military unit.

clue.text: Dance for cast

definitions.meaning: a Highland dance, as in the Highland ___
to cast something is to throw or hurl it

explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word between the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: The Highland ___ is a Scottish dance, and to throw is to cast.

clue.text: German agreement on port wine

indicators.note: on in an across clue means the German word follows the port

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro, the Brazilian seaport
ja is German for yes

explanation.surface: A German says yes to a fortified wine from Portugal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'port' wants to be the fortified wine; it is the Brazilian city RIO.
explanation.definitionFit: Rioja is a red wine from the Spanish region of that name.

clue.text: Old soldier, one from Arab state

parts.note: a man is a private soldier, as in officers and men
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A veteran has come from a Middle Eastern country.
explanation.definitionFit: Omani describes a person or thing belonging to Oman, a sultanate on the Arabian Peninsula.

clue.text: Is 21 a job for them?

parts.note: the answer to 21 split up reads as a task for C of E, the Church of England

explanation.walkthrough: 21 split differently reads TASK FOR CE: a job for the Church of England, CE being its usual abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the Church of England are the CE whose task the clue reads into 21.

clue.text: Becoming ready to learn

definitions.meaning: becoming as an adjective means suitable or fitting
a quick pupil is said to be this, as in quick and willing to learn

explanation.definitionFit: Apt means fitting, like becoming behaviour, and also quick at learning, like an able pupil.

clue.text: Medicine man?

definitions.meaning: a dose of liquid medicine to be drunk
a man is a piece in the board game played on a chequered board, so one counter

explanation.walkthrough: In British English the board game checkers is called draughts, and each piece is one of these.
explanation.definitionFit: A dose of liquid medicine is a draught, and a checkers piece is a draught in Britain.

clue.text: Artist originally chosen for classical work

indicators.note: originally means the word for chosen comes at the start, before the artist

parts.note: elect means chosen, as in the president elect
RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist

explanation.surface: A painter was first picked to produce a piece of ancient literature.
explanation.walkthrough: RA, Royal Academician, is a standard crossword artist; 'originally' puts ELECT first.
explanation.definitionFit: Electra is a Greek tragedy by both Sophocles and Euripides.
